title: Vikram and Betal: The Generous Farmer

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a generous farmer.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a farmer with a good harvest.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The farmer shared his crops with poor villagers.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer giving food to villagers cartoon

scenes.text: People asked why he shared his food.

scenes.summary: The farmer faces a bad year.
scenes.text: The farmer’s crops failed the next year.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer looking at empty field cartoon

scenes.text: Villagers helped him in return. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: villagers helping farmer with food cartoon

story: A generous farmer shared his harvest and was helped in return when he needed it. Vikram said kindness always returns.
